ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Adds one new pull_request-only, deliberately non-gate step to ci.yml (Check-body suspects, advisory, non-blocking) in the same job as the Keystone AC gate and P3.7 feeder checks (#702, #711): reads the same regenerated traceability manifest and real git history, but its own CLI (check_test_body_suspects.py) returns exit 0 unconditionally, so it can never become a merge blocker even by accident -- strictly weaker trust posture than its siblings, never stronger. Provenance for the bundling decision is trg-33a474e2 (filed by P3.7's own runner, amended by an operator to bundle in trg-c2329759, p3.8's own tracker card; trg-d03a239d was filed before that real card surfaced -- see the design doc Section 12).
